name: file-upload-card
title: File Upload Card
description: A card component for displaying uploaded file state with thumbnail, progress, and actions.

docs.lead: A compound card component for displaying uploaded files with thumbnails, upload progress, error states, and remove actions. Supports document, image, video, and audio file types.
docs.usage:
import * as FileUploadCard from "@/components/ui/file-upload-card"
import * as FileFormatIcon from "@/components/ui/file-format-icon"

<FileUploadCard.Root>
  <FileUploadCard.Thumbnail>
    <FileFormatIcon.Root format="PDF" color="red" />
  </FileUploadCard.Thumbnail>
  <FileUploadCard.Content>
    <FileUploadCard.Body>
      <FileUploadCard.Name>File.pdf</FileUploadCard.Name>
      <FileUploadCard.Meta>2.5 MB</FileUploadCard.Meta>
    </FileUploadCard.Body>
    <FileUploadCard.Actions>
      <FileUploadCard.RemoveButton />
    </FileUploadCard.Actions>
  </FileUploadCard.Content>
</FileUploadCard.Root>

examples.title: Compact: Uploading
examples.description: Compact variant with inline icon, description, status, and progress bar.
examples.code:
<FileUploadCard.CompactRoot>
  <FileUploadCard.CompactContent>
    <FileFormatIcon.Root format="PDF" color="red" size="medium" />
    <FileUploadCard.CompactBody>
      <FileUploadCard.Name>my-cv.pdf</FileUploadCard.Name>
      <FileUploadCard.CompactDescription>
        <FileUploadCard.Meta>0 KB of 120 KB</FileUploadCard.Meta>
        <FileUploadCard.Dot />
        <FileUploadCard.CompactStatus status="uploading">Uploading...</FileUploadCard.CompactStatus>
      </FileUploadCard.CompactDescription>
    </FileUploadCard.CompactBody>
    <FileUploadCard.CloseButton />
  </FileUploadCard.CompactContent>
  <FileUploadCard.Progress value={10} />
</FileUploadCard.CompactRoot>

examples.title: Compact: Failed
examples.description: Compact variant with red error border, retry link, and delete button.
examples.code:
<FileUploadCard.CompactRoot error>
  <FileUploadCard.CompactContent>
    <FileFormatIcon.Root format="PDF" color="red" size="medium" />
    <FileUploadCard.CompactErrorBody>
      <FileUploadCard.CompactBody>
        <FileUploadCard.Name>my-cv.pdf</FileUploadCard.Name>
        <FileUploadCard.CompactDescription>
          <FileUploadCard.Meta>0 KB of 120 KB</FileUploadCard.Meta>

          <FileUploadCard.CompactStatus status="failed">Failed</FileUploadCard.CompactStatus>
        </FileUploadCard.CompactDescription>
      </FileUploadCard.CompactBody>
      <FileUploadCard.RetryLink />
    </FileUploadCard.CompactErrorBody>
    <FileUploadCard.DeleteButton />

</FileUploadCard.CompactRoot>

api.name: FileUploadCard.Root
api.description: The card container with rounded border and shadow.

api.name: FileUploadCard.Thumbnail
api.description: Left-side thumbnail area (176×104px, gray background).

api.name: FileUploadCard.Image
api.description: An image thumbnail that fills the thumbnail area.

api.name: FileUploadCard.Video
api.description: A video thumbnail with a centered video icon overlay.

api.name: FileUploadCard.Audio
api.description: An audio thumbnail with a speaker icon.

api.name: FileUploadCard.Content
api.description: Right-side content area containing body and actions.

api.name: FileUploadCard.Body
api.description: Stacks filename, meta, and hint vertically with gap-1 (4px). Use for completed states.

api.name: FileUploadCard.UploadBody
api.description: Stacks info group and progress/retry vertically with gap-3 (12px). Use for uploading/failed states.

api.name: FileUploadCard.InfoGroup
api.description: Groups name and status with gap-1.5 (6px). Use inside UploadBody.

api.name: FileUploadCard.Name
api.description: The filename text (truncated).

api.name: FileUploadCard.Meta
api.description: Secondary info like file size.

api.name: FileUploadCard.Hint
api.description: Tertiary info like upload date or size recommendations.

api.name: FileUploadCard.Status
api.description: Upload status indicator with icon.

props.name: status
props.description: The upload status. Shows a spinner for uploading, error icon for failed.

api.name: FileUploadCard.Progress
api.description: A progress bar for upload progress.

api.name: FileUploadCard.RemoveButton
api.description: A red outline button for removing the file.

api.name: FileUploadCard.CloseButton
api.description: A subtle close (×) button for canceling uploads.

api.name: FileUploadCard.RetryLink
api.description: A red underlined link for retrying failed uploads.

api.name: FileUploadCard.CompactRoot
api.description: Compact card container without thumbnail area. Supports error border.

props.name: error
props.description: When true, applies a red error border.

api.name: FileUploadCard.CompactContent
api.description: Row layout for icon, text body, and action button.

api.name: FileUploadCard.CompactBody
api.description: Stacks name and description vertically with gap-1.

api.name: FileUploadCard.CompactErrorBody
api.description: Wraps CompactBody and RetryLink with gap-2. Use for failed states.

api.name: FileUploadCard.CompactDescription
api.description: Inline row for meta, dot separator, and status.

api.name: FileUploadCard.Dot
api.description: A dot separator (∙) for inline descriptions.

api.name: FileUploadCard.CompactStatus
api.description: Status indicator with icon for compact variant.

props.name: status
props.description: The upload status. Shows spinner, checkmark, or error icon.

api.name: FileUploadCard.DeleteButton
api.description: A subtle delete bin icon button for removing files.
